name: Late to the Party
source:
Late to the Party is a short visual novel about gathering the courage to interrupt your friends so you can come out to them.

[From [url=https://pizzapranks.itch.io/indiepocalypse-26]Indiepocalypse #26[/url]]
translation:
《派对迟到》是一部简短的视觉小说，讲述的是如何鼓起勇气打断你的朋友，这样你就可以向他们出柜。

[来自[url=https://pizzapranks.itch.io/indiepocalypse-26]Indiepocalypse #26[/url]]
